findings.text: Provides conversion from a sleeping thread preserved context into a debugger register buffer together with a program counter setter. Conversion clears the full buffer and carries over callee preserved general state plus frame pointer stack and program counter into defined positions, leaving all other positions cleared.

Defines debugger resume dispatch with a continue family, a step request, and a reject outcome. The continue family combines resume address refresh with single stepping disabled on the current processor. The step request combines resume address refresh with single stepping enabled or rewound. Resume refresh prefers an explicit address when supplied, otherwise applies a single instruction advance when a compiled stop marker is present, with the marker cleared in all cases.

Compiled stop marker is raised solely by the compiled stop path on entry to the generic debugger core and is consumed unconditionally by the next resume refresh, giving at most one automatic advance per compiled stop.

Exposes trap chain integration where inner handling forwards register context to the generic debugger core with handled versus stopped reporting, outer handling keeps interrupts masked across that delegation, the handler runs at lowest priority, and dedicated init and exit operations install and remove it.

Offers dynamic breakpoint management with preservation of the underlying instruction. Installation checks architected width compatibility, retains the existing word, and plants a debugger break word. Removal restores the retained word.

Provides a load gate that refuses ordinary images while processors remain stuck inside the kernel yet allows crash images regardless, a no-op cleanup hook kept for interface completeness, and a debug-only image introspection helper.
Requires every image segment extent derived from its recorded base and length to be made coherent to the point of coherency before hand-off.
Translation construction allocation supplies fully cleared pages on success and reports exhaustion without side effects.

Defines post load behavior with in-place and relocating modes. In-place mode provides coherence plus introspection only. Relocating mode provides hypervisor vector handling when non-hosted hypervisor mode is active, a cloned linear mapping, copied relocation code with its own identity mapping, recorded address adjustments, and data plus instruction coherence.

Supplies range based instruction cache maintenance to the point of unification with a capability fast path based on ordering only and a fallback that invalidates per cache line across the supplied extent.

Acts as non-returning hand-off with asynchronous exceptions masked. In-place images use an identity map with soft restart and start plus device tree context. Relocating images use a dedicated translation base with copied relocation code and optional hypervisor vector programming. Ordinary hand-off assumes a single live processor with no stuck processors while crash hand-off tolerates staleness with a reliability warning.
Crash stop liveness counts online processors excluding the caller, with any remaining other online processor meaning the stop attempt has failed.
Provides crash shutdown that quiets local interrupts, requests other processors to stop, preserves crashing processor register context, masks interrupt sources, and announces the pending dump kernel.

Specifies ordered processor stopping with once-only crash initiation. One entrant wins and snapshots peers excluding self. Escalation spans ordinary signalling with a long settle window, non-maskable signalling with a short window, and firmware assisted signalling with a medium window, with liveness re-sampled between rungs, a warning on persistent survivors, and local firmware masking on exit. Crash initiation adds a one-shot guard with firmware handler abort.

Exposes inter-processor signalling fan-out where a traced cross call forwards target mask and signal identity to a low level sender using either a single masked operation or per-processor operations depending on descriptor configuration.
Releases a physically contiguous reserved interval in page granularity, dropping the reservation on each frame within the bounds.

Publishes a file based loader table with image handling terminated by null and a post load cleanup that releases device tree and header resources, clears associated references and sizes, and delegates remaining teardown to the common default.

Reserves crash description capacity for exclusion bookkeeping plus heap plus one entry per physical memory range, and populates the description with inclusive intervals derived from each enumerated range.

Defines linkage entries as three word little-endian records combining a page relative address formation pair with a trailing branch. Generic entries use a fixed scratch register with cached branch encoding. Veneers for out-of-range formation preserve the original destination register and return to the instruction after the patched site.

Requires linkage allocation to select core versus init storage by emission address, to skip slots at forbidden offsets for page relative formation, to reuse the immediately preceding slot when it reaches the same target, and to enforce maximum capacity with warning and failure indication on overflow.

Constrains synthesized encodings to valid forms. Arithmetic forms accept only known operation and width selections with a limited immediate pattern and shift handling. Address forms accept only known page-relative kinds with a bounded signed offset. Register branch forms accept only known link and return kinds. Invalid inputs yield a fault encoding.

Keeps debugger notification under locally saved and restored interrupt masking, performs final hand-off with asynchronous exceptions masked, quiets interrupts before crash state capture, and allows only the first entrant into the processor stop sequence to proceed.

Treats unexpected liveness during hand-off as fatal for ordinary images and degraded reliability for crash images, warns on linkage capacity overflow and on peers surviving all stop rungs, and substitutes fault encodings for unrepresentable synthesis inputs.

Register buffer slots nineteen through twenty-eight carry callee preserved general state, slot twenty-nine carries frame pointer, slot thirty-one carries stack pointer, and slot thirty-two carries program counter, with all other slots zero on construction from sleeping context.
Dynamic debugger breakpoint storage width equals the fixed architected instruction width as enforced at build time.
File based kexec diagnostics carry a fixed subsystem prefix in logged output.
